rationale: This is an interpolation between two archived signals that already bracket it (the EV-denominator triple at alpha 0.057/t 5.23 and the equity-yield × liquidity pair at 0.056/t 5.23/Sharpe 0.52), so the denominator swap is a cosmetic variant whose outcome is largely predictable and whose incremental information is minimal.

The substitutes-vs-additive veto structure is a genuine economic claim about how the two defects combine and is not a rediscovery, though MIN and the product of two ranked gates are highly correlated so the expected incremental evidence is modest.

A clean, high-coverage ablation that separates the cash-asset side from the obligation side of the liquidity gate, but the gate leg is essentially the published cash-holdings premium (Palazzo/Simutin), so a positive result will be hard to distinguish from a known anomaly interacted with value.

The maturity-mix idea is legitimate and orthogonal to leverage level, but the scale-free construction contradicts its own stated economics by assigning the worst possible gate value to a firm with negligible debt that happens to be all current, while assigning the best value to debt-free firms — a mechanical artifact that will dominate the tails of the sort.

Scaling net cash by market cap converts the "safety gate" into a second valuation ratio (net-cash-to-price), which both double-counts cheapness with the yield leg and largely reproduces the already-tested enterprise-value denominator that nets cash and debt out of price.

The measurement-error amplification channel is conceptually distinct, but (xrd+xsga)/sale is close to one-minus-operating-margin by construction, so the gate proxies for *low* profitability and points against the sign the whole family's evidence supports — an internal tension the proposal does not address, and it overlaps the archived organization-capital/SG&A line.
